description: Multi-container orchestration with Docker Compose v2 — lifecycle, services, logs and build.

up.title: Start services
up.description: Creates and starts all services in the background (detached).

up-build.title: Start with rebuild
up-build.description: Rebuilds images and starts the services. Use after changing the Dockerfile.

down.title: Tear down services
down.description: Stops and removes the containers and the default network created by compose. Volumes are preserved.
warnings: Removes the containers; data outside named volumes is lost.

down-volumes.title: Tear down and delete volumes
down-volumes.description: Besides containers and network, removes named volumes — deletes persisted data (e.g. database).
arguments: Removes named volumes declared in the compose file.

ps.title: List services
ps.description: Shows the status of the project's containers (state, ports, health).

logs.title: View logs
logs.description: Follows the aggregated logs of all services; pass a name to filter.
examples: Follows the last 100 lines of the web service.

build.title: Build images
build.description: Builds (or rebuilds) the images of services that have a Dockerfile.
examples: Ignores the layer cache when building.

pull.title: Pull images
pull.description: Pulls the latest images for services defined with 'image:'.

restart.title: Restart services
restart.description: Restarts running containers without recreating them.
warnings: Doesn't apply image/config changes — use 'up -d --build' for that.

stop.title: Stop without removing
stop.description: Stops the containers but keeps them for a quick 'start' later.

exec.title: Run in a container
exec.description: Opens a shell (or runs a command) inside a running container.
examples: Opens psql inside the database service.
warnings: Changes made inside the container are lost if it is recreated.

run.title: Run a one-off container
run.description: Runs a single command in a new container of the service and removes it when done.

config.title: Validate/expand config
config.description: Renders and validates the final compose file (variables resolved, files merged).

top.title: Container processes
top.description: Shows the processes running inside each service.

scale.title: Scale a service
scale.description: Starts multiple replicas of a service (requires that it doesn't pin host ports).

rm.title: Remove stopped
rm.description: Removes containers of services that are already stopped.
